import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
import re
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.multiclass import OneVsRestClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import warnings
from html.parser import HTMLParser

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Create submission directory if it doesn't exist
submission_dir = "submission"
os.makedirs(submission_dir, exist_ok=True)

# Paths
train_path = "input/train.csv"
test_path = "input/test.csv"
sample_submission_path = "input/sample_submission.csv"

# Load data
print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv(train_path)
test_df = pd.read_csv(test_path)
sample_sub_df = pd.read_csv(sample_submission_path)

# Get target columns
target_cols = ["toxic", "severe_toxic", "obscene", "threat", "insult", "identity_hate"]


# Enhanced text preprocessing function
def clean_text(text):
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        return ""

    # Remove URLs
    text = re.sub(r"http[s]?://\S+|www\.\S+", "", text)

    # Remove @mentions and hashtags
    text = re.sub(r"@\w+", " ", text)
    text = re.sub(r"#\w+", " ", text)

    # Remove HTML tags
    text = re.sub(r"<[^>]+>", " ", text)

    # Remove HTML entities
    html_parser = HTMLParser()
    text = html_parser.escape(text)

    # Remove whitespace
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text).strip()

    return text.lower()


# Apply preprocessing
train_df["comment_text"] = train_df["comment_text"].apply(clean_text)
test_df["comment_text"] = test_df["comment_text"].apply(clean_text)

# Feature extraction using TF-IDF vectorizer with improved capacity
print("Creating TF-IDF vectorizer...")
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    lowercase=False,
    stop_words="english",
    ngram_range=(1, 2),
    max_features=100000,
    min_df=2,
)

# Fit vectorizer on training text only
vectorizer.fit(train_df["comment_text"])

X_train_tfidf = vectorizer.transform(train_df["comment_text"])
X_test_tfidf = vectorizer.transform(test_df["comment_text"])

# Encode target variables
y_train = train_df[target_cols].values.astype(float)

# Split training data for validation - non-stratified split for fair evaluation across all columns
X_train_valid, X_val_holdout, y_train_valid, y_val_holdout = train_test_split(
    X_train_tfidf, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, shuffle=False
)

# Train model with balanced class weights for each binary classifier
print("Training model...")
model = OneVsRestClassifier(
    LogisticRegression(
        C=1.0,
        penalty="l2",
        solver="liblinear",
        max_iter=1000,
        class_weight="balanced",  # Balance class weights for minority classes
        verbose=False,
    )
)

model.fit(X_train_valid, y_train_valid)

# Predict on validation set
val_probs = model.predict_proba(X_val_holdout)

# Calculate validation column-wise ROC AUC on hold-out data
roc_aucs = []
for i, col in enumerate(target_cols):
    true_positives = y_val_holdout[:, i]
    predicted_probabilities = val_probs[:, i].flatten()

    if true_positives.max() == true_positives.min():
        continue

    if len(true_positives) > 0 and len(predicted_probabilities) > 0:
        score = roc_auc_score(true_positives, predicted_probabilities)
        roc_aucs.append(score)

val_metric = np.mean(roc_aucs)
print(
    f"Validation Column-Wise ROC AUC: {val_metric:.4f} ({[round(s, 4) for s in roc_aucs]})"
)

# Predict on test set
test_pred_probs = model.predict_proba(X_test_tfidf)

# Prepare submission dataframe
print("Preparing submission file...")
submit_df = sample_sub_df.copy().reset_index(drop=True)
submit_df["id"] = submit_df["id"].astype(str)

submit_df["toxic"] = test_pred_probs[:, 0].tolist()
submit_df["severe_toxic"] = test_pred_probs[:, 1].tolist()
submit_df["obscene"] = test_pred_probs[:, 2].tolist()
submit_df["threat"] = test_pred_probs[:, 3].tolist()
submit_df["insult"] = test_pred_probs[:, 4].tolist()
submit_df["identity_hate"] = test_pred_probs[:, 5].tolist()

# Save to correct location
submit_df.to_csv(f"{submission_dir}/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to {submission_dir}/submission.csv")
print(f"Total rows submitted: {len(submit_df)}")

# Print final metric for evaluation tracking
print(f"Final Validation Metric: {val_metric:.4f}")
